description:
Replay a Maestro flow on the phone with no model in the loop: a file (path) or inline YAML (yaml). Runs launchApp, tapOn, longPressOn, inputText, eraseText, pressKey, back, swipe, scroll, scrollUntilVisible, assertVisible, assertNotVisible, extendedWaitUntil, waitForAnimationToEnd, takeScreenshot, runFlow, repeat and codedroidTask (CodeDroid's own agent); any other command fails the run where it is, so a pass means every step ran. assertVisible waits up to 7 s as in Maestro. ${VAR} comes from the flow's env and the env argument.

The phone is held for the whole run. A run longer than 50 s answers "running": call again with the same path or yaml to keep waiting. The reply lists each step's result and, after a failure, the screen's first lines: drive the rest by hand from there, or fix the flow. screenshot_dir (in the project or temp) is where takeScreenshot steps save their images.

device.description: Which paired phone runs this: its id, or its model or part of it, as codedroid_devices lists them. Required when several phones are paired.

path.description: A flow file in the project (relative to it, or absolute) or the temp directory.

screenshot_dir.description: Where takeScreenshot steps save their images (in the project or temp). Default: beside the flow file, under screenshots/.

yaml.description: The flow's YAML, instead of a file.

name: run_flow
title: Replay a flow
